opportunities.name: Book + film adaptation note
opportunities.description: For a given book title, look up its most popular Project Gutenberg edition (author, download count) and its IMDb film adaptation (year, rating), then save a 'Unit:' note.
steps: On Project Gutenberg, type {book_title} in Quick search and click Go!
Open the top result by popularity and record the author and download count
On IMDb, type {book_title} in the search box and submit
Pick the chosen film adaptation and record its year and rating
In Notes, type 'Unit: {title} by {author} ({downloads} downloads). Film: {year}, rated {rating}' in New note and press Enter

instances.values: Frankenstein -> Mary Wollstonecraft Shelley, 160188 downloads; film 2025, rated 7.4
Pride and Prejudice -> Jane Austen, 192356 downloads; film 2005, rated 7.8
Treasure Island -> Robert Louis Stevenson, 35366 downloads; film 1990, rated 7.0

opportunities.name: Country geography note
opportunities.description: For a given country, get its capital, population, languages and currency from Wikipedia and the current time in the capital from timeanddate, then save a 'Geography:' note.
steps: On Wikipedia, search for {country} and open the country article
Record the capital, population, official languages and currency from the infobox
On timeanddate.com, search the World Clock for {capital} and open the matching city
Record the current local time and time zone
In Notes, type 'Geography: {country}, capital {capital}, pop {population}, {languages}, {currency}, time now {time} {tz}' and press Enter

instances.values: Peru / Lima -> pop 34,157,732, Spanish/Quechua/Aymara, PEN, 12:55:16 PET
Vietnam / Hanoi -> pop 102,300,000, Vietnamese, VND, 01:00:03 ICT
Morocco / Rabat -> Arabic and Amazigh, MAD, 18:05:56 GMT

opportunities.name: Viator museum ticket search
opportunities.description: Search Viator for '{museum} tickets' and open the top listing to check price and rating.
steps: Close the cookie banner if it appears (Reject All)
Type '{museum} tickets' in the Where to?/search box
Submit the search (skip the date picker)
Look over the result cards, then click the top listing to see price and rating
